job.label: Short bow — Masterwork
job.keep_line: the same single short deep D-curved ash bow, upper nock at upper-left and lower nock at lower-right of its gentle diagonal, thick short limbs tapering to rounded nocks, broad spirally rawhide-wrapped grip on the curved right side and a single straight taut dark string closing the D on the left. Preserve the exact limb curvature, wood facets, nock-end cord bindings, rawhide overlaps, open interior and string endpoints; the nocks do not curl or reflex. Pale ash and natural tan rawhide, no coloured maker accent. No arrow, quiver or added hardware.
job.prompt:
Create the Masterwork-finish cosmetic variant of the attached fictional RPG short bow inventory painting for Project Heaven Cry. This is a 2D digital game-art asset. FIRST attachment fixes Standard geometry and registration: a single deep D-shaped short bow, rounded nocks at upper-left and lower-right, broad spiral grip wrap on the curved right side, straight taut string closing the D on the left. Preserve exact limb curvature, every opening, nock/string endpoints, grip overlaps, pose, scale, camera and margins. SECOND is the preceding grade: retain its additions except the current material changes. THIRD is Heavenprint brushwork reference only, never a person or scene.

Grade: Masterwork. Keep everything of the Fine grade. Inlay the line with the item's accent colour (bright brass if it has no accent): one clear stripe along each limb, along the stock, or down the quiver. The nock tips are capped in polished horn or brass, flush with the limb ends; the grip is wrapped in fine dark leather in an even pattern; the prod and metal fittings are crisp and bright; the quiver's rim is bound with a neat edge and its buckle polished.

The continuous inlay is bright brass, following the two preceding Fine carved lines exactly, one stripe along each actual limb. Nock caps are polished brass fitted flush inside the existing rounded nock shapes; preserve the cord binding endpoints and do not enlarge the tips. Refinish the existing grip wrap as fine dark leather using the same overlaps and routes. No ornament or repair yet. Apply this grade only to the actual bow parts shown; no stock, quiver, arrow, added fittings or extra object. No curled/reflexed tips. Do not add, remove, resize or move any part or opening. Hand-painted opaque gouache and ink with broken directional strokes, selective dry-brush, charcoal shadows, warm ivory focal edges and upper-left light. Full transparent background,1024x1024RGBA, same framing and at least50px clear margin. No cast shadow, ground, scene, figure, hand, text, letters, numbers, logo, label, frame or border. Exterior painted illustration only, no diagram, measurements, assembly steps or operating instructions.
